verdict.rationale: Cloud Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API, so existing MongoDB drivers, tools and integrations can talk to the database directly. That is a first-party path to standard clients. However, it is limited to the Firestore Enterprise edition, and the default Firestore and Realtime Database are reached through Firebase SDKs. missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, evidence of ORM/ODM support, availability outside the Enterprise edition, independent or hands-on corroboration that standard drivers work.
